Slay The Tism II - v1.0.0
=========================

Here be 'tism to be slain.

Replaces the main-menu title logo. The original title is a Spine (skeletal) animation, so this mod
hides its text with a discard shader and draws the replacement art over the same bounds. The potion
flames the skeleton scatters around the title are kept, including the one on the "i".


Install
-------
1. Close Slay the Spire 2.
2. Copy the "SlayTheTismII" folder into:
     <Steam library>\steamapps\common\Slay the Spire 2\mods\
   (Create the "mods" folder if it does not exist.)
3. Launch the game and enable "Slay The Tism II" in Settings -> Mod Settings.

The folder must contain:

  SlayTheTismII.json   manifest (required)
  SlayTheTismII.dll    the mod (required)
  Title.png            the replacement title art (required)
  mod_image.png        preview image for the in-game mod list (optional)
  SlayTheTismII.pdb    debug symbols (optional)


Uninstall
---------
Delete the "SlayTheTismII" folder from mods/.


Notes
-----
- Requires Slay the Spire 2 v0.107.0 or newer. Built against v0.111.0.
- No game files are modified; removing the folder restores the vanilla title.
- Optional tuning file: create "logo.json" next to the DLL with:
    {
      "delay": 0,
      "fade": 0.6,
      "scale": 1.0,
      "offset_x": 0,
      "offset_y": 0,
      "hide_vanilla": true,
      "keep_fires": true
    }
